status.en: 6 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Aleppo and Quneitra.
status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Aleppo og Quneitra.

summary.en: Lebanese army seized 264 kg of explosives smuggled from Syria and Syrian authorities seized a weapons shipment bound for Lebanon, indicating ongoing cross-border illicit trade. Syrian forces destroyed 400 million captagon pills in raids and a Syrian soldier was killed with two injured during a mine-clearing operation in Deir ez-Zor. Russian strikes killed three children in Aleppo, while Turkish accusations link Israel to arming Druze fighters in southern Syria. The United Nations recognized Syria's anti-drug and anti-crime efforts, and 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den libanesiske hæren beslagla 264 kg sprengstoff smuglet fra Syria, og syriske myndigheter beslagla en våpensending på vei til Libanon, noe som viser pågående grenseoverskridende ulovlig handel. Syriske styrker ødela 400 millioner captagon-piller i raid, og en syrisk soldat ble drept og to ble såret under en minefjerning i Deir ez-Zor. Russiske angrep drepte tre barn i Aleppo, mens tyrkiske anklager knytter Israel til våpenforsyning av drus-krefter i sørlige Syria. FN anerkjente Syriens innsats mot narkotika og kriminalitet, og 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
